description: A Framework to Guide Performance-based Assessment of Buildings Following Extreme Events is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Amir Safiey, Auburn University (auburn.edu). This project includes supplementary information of a manuscript titled "A Framework to Guide Performance-based Assessment of Buildings Following Extreme Events. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-95kg-y369. Keywords: wind engineering, earthquake engineering, post disaster assessmnets, perfroamnce-based engineering, perishable data. Published 2024-04-18. Facility named: StEER - Structural Engineering Extreme Event Reconnaissance. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
